Nodes.Text: Greetings, traveler! Welcome to our village. How may I assist you?
This is a peaceful farming village. We've been here for generations, growing crops and raising livestock. The villagers are friendly, and we rarely have trouble.
The forest to the north can be dangerous at night. We've heard strange noises coming from there. During the day, it's safe enough, but I'd recommend staying on the main paths.
Howling, mostly. Some of the villagers say they've seen glowing eyes in the darkness. I haven't seen it myself, but I trust their word. Best to stay away after sunset.

Choices.Text: That's concerning. I'll keep my guard up.

Nodes.Text: I wouldn't recommend that, traveler. We've lost a few people who went into the forest at night. If you must go, at least wait until morning and bring a weapon.
Hmm, now that you mention it... There was a stranger who came through yesterday. Didn't say much, just asked about the old ruins to the east. Seemed in a hurry.

Choices.Text: I see. Thanks for the information.

Nodes.Text: Tall, wearing a dark cloak. Had a scar across their left cheek. Carried themselves like someone who's seen combat. They left heading east toward the ruins.

Choices.Text: I'll keep an eye out. Thanks!

Nodes.Text: The ruins are ancient, predating our village by centuries. No one goes there much - it's said to be cursed. The stranger seemed very interested in them, though.

Choices.Text: Interesting. I might check them out.

Nodes.Text: Old stories say that anyone who disturbs the ruins will bring misfortune upon themselves. I don't know if it's true, but I've never heard of anyone who went there and came back unchanged.

Choices.Text: That's quite a story. I'll be careful.

Nodes.Text: Safe travels, traveler! If you need anything else, just ask.
